newItems.name: Herbe Pouvoir
newItems.description: Supprime le tour de préparation d’une capacité à charger. Sans effet sur Chute Libre ni les tours de recharge. Utilisation unique pendant le combat ; restitué au propriétaire à la fin du combat.

newItems.name: Ballon
newItems.description: Rend le porteur insensible aux attaques Sol tant qu’il flotte. Éclate après un coup reçu, même sur un clone. Gravité et les effets qui l’ancrent au sol annulent la lévitation. Utilisation unique pendant le combat ; restitué au propriétaire à la fin du combat.

newItems.name: Vulné-Assurance
newItems.description: Augmente l’Attaque et l’Attaque Spéciale de deux crans après une attaque super efficace qui retire des PV au porteur survivant. Sans effet sur un clone ou des dégâts fixes. Utilisation unique pendant le combat ; restitué au propriétaire à la fin du combat.

newItems.name: Pare-Effet
newItems.description: Protège des réactions adverses au contact : Casque Brut, Peau Dure, Épine de Fer, Corps Ardent, Statik et boucliers piquants notamment. L’attaque conserve son contact pour les bonus et talents du porteur.

mechanics: 18 type boosters +20% base power, keeping Technician’s threshold before item power boosts; no bonus to fixed damage.

White/Mental/Power Herbs, Balloon and Weakness Policy consumed once per battle and restored to their original player owner at cleanup, matching the game’s Focus Sash rule, including Trick/theft. Berries retain existing consumption.
Balloon immunity respects Gravity, grounding and item suppression; bursts on HP or Substitute hits, including delayed moves; visible entry announcement is public to AI.
Weakness Policy needs surviving HP damage with super effectiveness; not fixed damage, Substitute, hazards or immunity. Delayed hits supported.

White Herb removes negative stages only; Mental Herb cures infatuation, Taunt, Encore, Disable, Torment and Heal Block. Power Herb skips charge, not recharge or Sky Drop; not spent for sunlight Solar Beam or before being allowed to act.
Light Clay screens eight turns; weather rocks matching weather moves and entry abilities eight turns; permanent map weather unchanged.
Big Root +30% recovery from draining moves, Leech Seed, Aqua Ring, Ingrain and Strength Sap, with Heal Block and reversed Liquid Ooze; damage unchanged.
Black Sludge heals Poison 1/16, otherwise harms 1/8, respecting Magic Guard, suppression and Heal Block.
Shed Shell permits voluntary switching past traps including Fairy Lock, but not forced move/charge, Sky Drop or prohibited fleeing.
Protective Pads suppress defensive contact reactions, Rocky Helmet, Spiky Shield and Pickpocket; preserve contact for Tough Claws, Fluffy and own Poison Touch; Cursed Body and move recoil unchanged.
Fling powers checked against primary implementation; Poison Barb poisons, White/Mental Herbs help the recipient, not through Substitute.
Deterministic AI projection updated for new effects without reading a submitted action or consuming live RNG; opposing held items stay private except publicly announced Balloon.
limits: A focused addition of 32 useful held items, not a claim to implement every competitive item from all generations.

Gen1–4 species scope retained; the game’s existing mixed-generation item/move policy permits Fairy Feather and Protective Pads. No new species, forms, held Plates/Multitype changes or mega/Z mechanics.
Full suite retains the same 28 existing failures; no unrelated map/story/mode tests rewritten. Browser WebKit is not a physical iPhone test.
No real account manually edited; no schema/migration, no mode reopening, no neighboring app changes.
